import requests, json, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def fasta_seq(acc):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=30)
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) if r.status_code==200 else None
human_sult1 = {"SULT1A1":"P50225","SULT1A2":"P50226","SULT1A3":"P0DMM9","SULT1A4":"P0DMN0",
 "SULT1B1":"O43704","SULT1C2":"O00338","SULT1C3":"Q6IMI4","SULT1C4":"O75897","SULT1E1":"P49888"}
ortho = {"Human_P50225":"P50225","Bovine_P50227":"P50227","Rat_P17988":"P17988","Mouse_P52840":"P52840",
 "Dog_Q29476":"Q29476","MacFas_P52846":"P52846","MacMul_I0FUK1":"I0FUK1","Marmoset_U3FKM3":"U3FKM3",
 "GoldMole_A0A9B0X0N4":"A0A9B0X0N4","Hamster_A0AAU9ZLM0":"A0AAU9ZLM0"}
para={n:fasta_seq(a) for n,a in human_sult1.items()}
oseq={n:fasta_seq(a) for n,a in ortho.items()}
human=para["SULT1A1"]

aas="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZX*"
b62_str="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0 -2 -1 0 -4

rows=b62_str.split("\n"); B={}
for i,a in enumerate(aas):
    vals=rows[i].split()
    for j,b in enumerate(aas): B[(a,b)]=int(vals[j])
def sc(a,b): return B.get((a,b), B.get((b,a),-1))
def nw_to_ref(ref, seq, go=-11, ge=-1):
    n,m=len(ref),len(seq); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+(j-1)*ge
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(ref[i-1],seq[j-1])
            cand=[M[i-1,j-1]+s,Ix[i-1,j-1]+s,Iy[i-1,j-1]+s]; k=int(np.argmax(cand)); M[i,j]=cand[k]; tb[i,j,0]=k
            cand=[M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(cand)); Ix[i,j]=cand[k]; tb[i,j,1]=k
            cand=[M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(cand)); Iy[i,j]=cand[k]; tb[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); rp={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if state==0: rp[i]=seq[j-1]; k=tb[i,j,0]; i-=1; j-=1; state=k
        elif state==1: rp[i]='-'; k=tb[i,j,1]; i-=1; state=k
        else: k=tb[i,j,2]; j-=1; state=k
        if i==0 and j==0: break
    return rp
ortho_aln={n:nw_to_ref(human,s) for n,s in oseq.items()}
para_aln={n:nw_to_ref(human,s) for n,s in para.items() if n!="SULT1A1"}

acc_pos=[24,76,81,84,89,106,108,142,148,240,247]
catalytic={106,108}  # PSB/catalytic His-Lys (chemistry, not acceptor identity)
def fid(aln,pos):
    h=human[pos-1]; col=[d.get(pos,'-') for d in aln.values()]
    return np.mean([1.0 if r==h else 0.0 for r in col])
allpos=list(range(1,len(human)+1))
bg=[p for p in allpos if p not in acc_pos]
o_id={p:fid(ortho_aln,p) for p in allpos}
p_id={p:fid(para_aln,p) for p in allpos}

o_acc=np.array([o_id[p] for p in acc_pos]); o_bg=np.array([o_id[p] for p in bg])
p_acc=np.array([p_id[p] for p in acc_pos]); p_bg=np.array([p_id[p] for p in bg])

print("=== Test A: are acceptor positions MORE conserved than scaffold WITHIN orthologs? ===")
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(o_acc,o_bg,alternative='greater')
print(f"ortho acceptor median %ID {np.median(o_acc):.3f} vs bg {np.median(o_bg):.3f}; MWU greater p={pv:.3f}")
print(f"ortho acceptor mean {o_acc.mean():.3f} vs bg {o_bg.mean():.3f} (delta {o_acc.mean()-o_bg.mean():+.3f})")

print("\n=== Test B: are acceptor positions MORE conserved than scaffold ACROSS paralogs? ===")
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(p_acc,p_bg,alternative='greater')
print(f"para acceptor mean {p_acc.mean():.3f} vs bg {p_bg.mean():.3f} (delta {p_acc.mean()-p_bg.mean():+.3f}); MWU greater p={pv:.3f}")
u,pv2=stats.mannwhitneyu(p_acc,p_bg,alternative='less')
print(f"  test acceptor LESS conserved across paralogs: MWU less p={pv2:.4f}")

print("\n=== Test C: lineage-differentiation (ortho%ID - para%ID): pocket vs scaffold ===")
d_acc=o_acc-p_acc; d_bg=o_bg-p_bg
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(d_acc,d_bg,alternative='greater')
print(f"delta(ortho-para) acceptor mean {d_acc.mean():.3f} vs bg {d_bg.mean():.3f}; MWU greater p={pv:.3f}")

print("\nPer-position (F247 excluded? no):")
print(f"{'pos':7}{'ortho':>7}{'para':>7}{'o-p':>7}  role")
for p in acc_pos:
    role='CATALYTIC' if p in catalytic else 'pocket'
    print(f"{str(p):7}{o_id[p]:7.2f}{p_id[p]:7.2f}{o_id[p]-p_id[p]:7.2f}  {role}")

# Non-catalytic hydrophobic pocket only
poc=[p for p in acc_pos if p not in catalytic]
o_poc=np.array([o_id[p] for p in poc])
print(f"\nHydrophobic pocket only (n={len(poc)}): ortho mean {o_poc.mean():.3f} vs bg {o_bg.mean():.3f}")
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(o_poc,o_bg,alternative='greater')
print(f"  MWU greater p={pv:.3f}")

# ---- Figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.boxplot([o_bg,o_acc,p_bg,p_acc],labels=['ortho\nscaffold','ortho\npocket','paralog\nscaffold','paralog\npocket'])
ax.set_ylabel('Fraction identical to human SULT1A1')
ax.set_title('Conservation: pocket vs scaffold')
ax.axhline(o_bg.mean(),ls='--',c='gray',alpha=.5)
ax=axes[1]
x=np.arange(len(acc_pos))
ax.bar(x-0.2,[o_id[p] for p in acc_pos],width=0.4,label='orthologs',color='steelblue')
ax.bar(x+0.2,[p_id[p] for p in acc_pos],width=0.4,label='human paralogs',color='indianred')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f'{human[p-1]}{p}' for p in acc_pos],rotation=45)
ax.set_ylabel('%ID to human SULT1A1'); ax.set_title('Per-residue acceptor-pocket conservation'); ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("acceptor_conservation.png",dpi=120)
